title: Chapter 2947 - 175: Deadly Vendetta (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 2947: Chapter 175: Deadly Vendetta (Part 2)

However, while the enemies of other Barbaric Tribes are out in the open, the Hua family lurks in the shadows.

But now, for Mo Hua, whether they are in the open or hiding is no longer important.

The Money Rat is definitely related to the Hua family and wants to take his life, to prevent his Core Formation. Therefore, this "Hua family" must be destroyed.

Mo Hua showed no mercy.

In the ensuing battles, Lugu carried out Mo Hua’s "secret order," settling scores with various forces parasitized by the Hua family in the Barbaric Wilderness.

The Mountain Realm, tainted by the Hua family, was attacked first.

Any cultivator of the Hua family caught was killed.

Barbarian Tribes associated with the Hua family were thoroughly "cleansed."

Anyone with close ties to the Hua family almost certainly already sold out a great deal of tribal interests, and these people were put to death without exception.

When encountering a secret "stronghold" of the Hua family, Mo Hua would set Sishen upon them.

This Undying General, under the Divine Blessing’s command at the Late Golden Core Stage, almost invincible with the augmentation of the Taotie Pattern, could nearly single-handedly kill all the "living" in the stronghold, devouring the Golden Cores... leaving the Hua family in terror.

This continued for quite some time.

The Hua family suffered many casualties; supported forces were cleared out one by one, their territory shrank, secret lines were uprooted, and they suffered significant setbacks, leaving many of their businesses in ruins.

The Hua family was furious, especially Elder You.

Ruining his business was as grievous as killing his parents.

He began to pay a hefty price to win over other major tribes, supporting new forces to fight against Mo Hua.

At the same time, sparing no expense, he sought to infiltrate Mo Hua’s realm, using legacies, fame, and allure to corrupt the chieftains and elders loyal to Mo Hua.

Most who held faith maintained absolute loyalty to the Divine Lord and would not be "corrupted."

But some Barbarian Cultivators, tempted by enjoyment of fame and allure, gradually began to waver in their faith, shifting their true intentions, secretly working for Elder You, stealing tribal interests, and even daring to secretly assist in plotting against Mo Hua, the "Divine Blessing."

These individuals were ordered by Mo Hua to be beheaded and displayed at the entrances of the tribes as a warning.

Mo Hua also began to use a similar tactic to control the "faith" of some internal cultivators of the Hua family.

Thus, Mo Hua and the Hua family, especially Elder You, in this "chess game" of the Barbaric Wilderness, used tribes as pieces to kill and conquer each other’s territories.

They also set up "dark moves" against each other, using legacies to entice the Taoist Heart, using wealth and allure to corrupt human desires, continually plotting defection and rebellion...

From the year 20,043 of the Taoist Calendar, the tenth year of the Great Wilderness New Calendar, the second year of Divine Blessing, to the twelfth year of the Great Wilderness New Calendar, the fourth year of Divine Blessing.

In just two years, Mo Hua and the Hua family, in both overt and covert ways, through battles and intrigue, played countless games of "chess."

There were visible bloody storms and invisible undercurrents.

During this time, Mo Hua gained the upper hand but also encountered setbacks, sacrificing a significant number of troops.

He occupied some of the Hua family’s territories, but also experienced losses to secret provocations by the Hua family, losing some of the Mountain Realm.

He captured the Hua family’s captives, controlling the "faith" of these Hua family disciples.

But some of his chieftains, elders, close followers, and disciples under his command also encountered Hua family’s corruption and "betrayed" him.

Mo Hua was even forced to painfully kill some disciples he personally trained, who had fallen into temptation from the Hua family’s inducements and lost their Taoist Heart.

...

In these various confrontations, the "hatred" between both sides grew deeper and deeper.

Everyone in the Hua family, from the strategizing Hua family patriarch behind the scenes to Elder You, engaging in business dealings on the front lines, to the even lower-level Hua family disciples responsible for execution, and the tribal forces loyal to the Hua family...

All bore an intense hatred for the title "Divine Blessing."

"In business, harmony brings wealth, and in this world, there are no eternal enemies, only eternal interests."

This had been the "life principle" Elder You had always followed.

But now, his "principle" was distorted.

Indeed, there are eternal "enemies" in this world.

That enemy is the "Divine Blessing," who, in the name of the Divine Lord, is spreading among Barbarian Cultivators, aiming to unify the Great Wilderness and save all beings.

He is the one with a face like white jade, eyes like goldstones, appearing as a teenager but with an aura of dignity and coldness, without a trace of human warmth...

The Great Wilderness Divine Blessing.

This Divine Blessing is the Hua family’s greatest enemy in the Great Wilderness.

His threat level, to date, even surpasses that of the Great Wilderness Royal Court.

Because, even with the rebel forces of the Great Wilderness Royal Court, the Hua family can negotiate and do business.

But this Divine Blessing is different.

This Divine Blessing is determined to ruin the Hua family’s business, seize their Spirit Stones, kill their people, and extinguish their roots in the Great Wilderness.

Of course, the Hua family will not rest until this is avenged.

Mo Hua at the Foundation Establishment has almost surpassed many Feather Transformation and Heaven Void cultivators and has ascended onto the Hua family’s "must-kill" list for the entire family.

However, he is now on this must-kill list in the name of "Divine Blessing."

Mo Hua, on the other hand, will also not rest until this is avenged.

He must kill all the Hua family cultivators in the Great Wilderness, seize all their Spirit Stones, and burn all their strongholds.

He aims to eradicate all the "pieces" of the Hua family in the Great Wilderness.

Their power in the Barbaric Wilderness is to be uprooted.

The hatred between both sides is irreconcilable, leaving no room for concession.

However... no matter how Mo Hua advances, in the overt and covert disputes and conflicts with the Hua family, he can only gain the upper hand and cannot turn this advantage into "victory" to eradicate the Hua family’s roots in the Barbaric Wilderness.
